business: VIZA helps international travellers understand visa and entry requirements, prepare applications, and use an assisted application service. Readers include individual applicants and travel planners across English-speaking markets.
voice: Use calm, practical English and explain uncertainty plainly.
Never promise approval, processing time, eligibility, or a fee without a direct official source.
Keep agency services distinct from government decisions and official fees.
No em dashes or invented urgency.
